title: Prepare a fixed-base nightly candidate without pending changesets

setupFiles.monochange.toml:
[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"
[package."@acme/api"]
path = "packages/api"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/ui"]
path = "packages/ui"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/tokens"]
path = "packages/tokens"
type = "npm"
[group.main]
packages = ["@acme/api", "@acme/ui", "@acme/tokens"]
version_format = "primary"
[ecosystems.npm]
enabled = true
[lints.rules]
"npm/workspace-protocol" = "off"

prompt: Set up a nightly binary trial without changesets. Configure prerelease mode with channel nightly, increment numbering, fixed stable base 0.0.0, and registry publishing off. Prepare exactly one candidate locally so I can inspect manifests and the persisted prerelease state. Do not create fake release notes, publish, tag, or push.
expectation: With no pending changesets, fixed-base prerelease preparation still releases the configured main group at 0.0.0-nightly.0, stamps manifests, persists state, and invents no release intent.

checks.why: Nightly preparation must persist its explicit fixed base with registry publishing disabled.
Fixed-base prereleases must honor their explicit binary version.
Persisted state must retain the fixed base and current nightly counter.
A no-changeset binary trial must not fabricate release notes.
Evaluation is limited to local planning and preparation; registry, tag, release, and push operations are outside the task.
